svg.title: A host doc comment read top to bottom. Left: eight comment lines (markers InCS+-, InJAVA+-, InJAVA-- with group RowsResult and Row, InJAVA+-, InCS- with group Payload). Middle: the running setting for C# and Java after each line; group lines receive a copy of all languages. Right: the result per pack and language; the default row is the copy of the last marker with no group, line 6. Bottom: a pitfall where a group copied C# ++ before the C# marker.
svg.text: How a host comment is read: one running setting for all languages
Running setting after the line (C# | Java)
before the first marker: every language ++
last marker with no group = host default
second character: equality and hash (+ yes, - no)
Pitfall: a copy holds every language

text.tspan: (it took its copy before the C# marker)
(the default: the copy of InCS+-, the last marker with no group)
